summary: Frontend-only validation of NotificationBell + browser/audio notifications on kasir & admin dashboards. All targeted behaviors verified end-to-end: bell renders (mobile+desktop instances), popover controls present, WebAudio chime fires without errors, localStorage persistence works, SSE 'order_created' triggers notifyNewOrder() on /kasir/orders, /kasir dashboard, and /admin/orders with correctly-formatted desktop notification title and order-list refresh. Backend regression skipped per request (no backend changes in this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx is rendered twice in DOM (mobile top-bar + desktop floating) -> both share localStorage keys; this is intentional but tests must use .last (visible desktop) or :visible filter when asserting visibility. Consider gating second instance with React fragment + breakpoint at component level if duplicate event listeners ever cause double-fire (currently fine because notifyNewOrder is invoked from page components, not the Bell itself).
Order creation schema uses 'qty' and 'note' (not 'quantity'/'notes'). All page-side fetch helpers already comply; just a note for future tests.
Desktop notif title contains emoji '🔔 Pesanan baru #ORDERNUM' — confirmed via mock Notification spy.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ orders (#0027, #0028, #0029) via /api/orders POST to trigger SSE; non-destructive, only adds rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bell has 2 DOM instances per page (mobile + desktop layouts). Use page.locator('[data-testid="notif-bell"]').last for desktop. Mock Notification + AudioContext spy via page.add_init_script BEFORE goto. Order POST body: {table_number, items:[{product_id,name,price,qty,note}], payment_method:'tunai'|'qris'|'transfer'}. notifyNewOrder() title format: '🔔 Pesanan baru #ORDERNUM'. playUrgentChime fires 6 createOscillator() calls; playChime fires 3.

detailed_results.popover_controls: toggle-sound=1, toggle-desktop=1, test-sound-button=1, enable-desktop-button=0 (correctly hidden when permission='granted')
detailed_results.test_sound_chime: chimes incremented from 0->3 (playChime → 3 oscillators), no errors
detailed_results.localStorage_sound: off after toggle off, 'on' after toggle on (key: swm_notif_sound)
detailed_results.sse_kasir_orders: POST /api/orders 200, chimes=6 (playUrgentChime), desktop notif title='🔔 Pesanan baru #20260602-0027', errors=[]
detailed_results.sse_kasir_dashboard: POST /api/orders 200, chimes=6, desktop notif='🔔 Pesanan baru #20260602-0028', errors=[]
detailed_results.sse_admin_orders: POST /api/orders 200, chimes=6, desktop notif='🔔 Pesanan baru #20260602-0029', errors=[], order list refreshed (visually confirmed new rows at top of admin/orders table)
detailed_results.denied_permission_logic: Verified via code review in NotificationBell.jsx line 97 (disabled={perm==='denied'}) and conditional enable-button at line 102 (perm==='default' only). Sound toggle has no disabled prop → always works (chimes still fired post-toggle).
detailed_results.regression: /menu and /admin/products load OK with bell rendered
detailed_results.console_errors: None observed during full flow; only stray 'WebSocket dev HMR' chatter (preview env), unrelated to notifications.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects discovered. Feature implementation is correct and integrates cleanly with existing SSE pipeline.
